behavior: Preserve the _receipt_candidate signature and successful return behavior. All immutable facts are scoped to one invocation and discarded; independently resolve each named commit/path and validate its exact blob type/mode/bytes/digest. Identical OIDs never substitute for revision/path authority.

Retain exact source commit/tree and executed commit validation, anchor ancestry and literal origin binding before accepting the candidate. Preserve source/tests/tools checks at anchor and executed revision; contracts at anchor; canonical owned-record comparison and unowned raw-byte rules.

Read every current physical file and its mode afresh on every call; retain all existing regular_file checks and environment construction/comparison. Preserve caller hardlink rejection at its existing boundary; standalone acceptance must not invent a historical rejection it never had.

Batch literal Git paths safely: exact path set, no pathspec interpretation, descendant-directory expansion, symlink/tree/submodule substitution or path alias. Existing unusual valid names retain behavior. Use existing blobs validation; do not replace Git output framing/type checks.

Propagate intended AssuranceError rejection categories for isolated defects; setup failures remain distinct. No source-wide cache or retained verdict, including after missing-object availability or physical content changes.

independent_acceptance.readset: Evaluator builds an owned shallow-CI-compatible synthetic repository from shipped files, with at least16 distinct valid assessed source/tests/tools paths, both executable modes, distinct source/executed commits and owned/unowned contracts. Oracle uses unchanged shipped _entry_blob on the same exact (revision,path) readset; no unshipped historical Git object or wholesale historical source import.
independent_acceptance.process_metric: Delegate all counted immutable-read operations to real Git; record argv and launch count for old helper oracle and batched candidate read section on equivalent fixtures. Include commit resolution, ls-tree and cat-file launches in both denominators; classify fixed candidate/ancestor/origin identity operations separately. Require integer optimized_count*2 <= oracle_count, identical bytes/modes, and valid _receipt_candidate success. No fake subprocess result or elapsed-time criterion.
independent_acceptance.semantics: Positive and isolated intended reject controls for exact commit/tree/ancestor/origin, missing/nonblob/wrong-mode/digest inputs, literal unusual paths, current physical symlink/type/bytes/mode mutations, canonical owned/unowned fields and environment. Fresh repeat calls and restoration must reveal intervening changes. Each reject has its expected exception/cause, not blanket nonzero.
independent_acceptance.runner: Each of the four --check names in verification runs exactly its named invariant; default runs all four in fixed order. Unknown/missing checks/setup failures exit nonzero, with setup2 distinct from policy/test assertion1. Emit one distinct PASS label per completed named selector in default order; no aggregate-only success or auto-skips.
independent_acceptance.automatic_hook: fixtures_self_test.sh invokes the new default runner once and folds any nonzero into existing fail status. Missing runner must fail. Its existing166/166 denominator counts on-disk fixture files, not selectors: retain166 files and original48 Workflow Assurance order; record four new checks separately without inventing167 fixtures. No workflow edit is needed because existing capable fixture job invokes the shell suite.
independent_acceptance.authoring: Distinct Evaluator authors/freezes new runner and minimal shell hook before Generator implementation. Independent bundle review validates full tests/oracle/metric against spec and unchanged Source; changed frozen assertions require renewed review.
